title: Style tokens
description: A style's look and timing as data. tokens.css carries the same values as custom properties for the elements; this file is what the runtime reads for named easings and the timing unit, and what compare.py reads for palette and type scale.

palette.description: Named colours as hex, measured from the source (look.py k-means in Lab).

family.description: CSS font-family stack, with the matched or substituted face first.

scale.description: Named sizes in px at the source frame size.

tracking.description: Letter-spacing in em per scale step.

spacing.description: Named spacing in px, margins included, measured as the source's own margins.

unit_ms.description: The style's timing unit: the shortest recurring interval in the source. Durations, staggers and holds are counted in it.

easings.description: Named curves as cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2]. y may leave 0..1 for overshoot.
